public_rationale: The inspected disclosures do not establish either zero AI profit across all four companies or the stated remaining revenue gap. Meta described returns in its core business, which must be considered, but supplied no matching net-profit measure. AWS earnings and Alphabet segment results cover different scopes. The capex period, AI allocation, and recovery calculation remain unverified.
limitations: Failure to find separately disclosed AI profit is not evidence of zero profit.
Positive cloud or company earnings are not proof of positive AI-specific profit.
Meta's statement is qualitative management commentary, not an independently verified profit calculation.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Meta, Amazon, Google and Microsoft have yet to see a dollar of AI profit, leaving a $1.21 trillion hole to justify their capex.

statement.excerpt: Meta, Amazon, Google and Microsoft are already years and hundreds of billions of dollars in, and are yet to see a dollar of profit, creating a $1.21 trillion hole just to justify the expenses (so around $605 billion in capex all told, at the time I calculated it).
statement.document_title: NVIDIA Isn't Enron - So What Is It?

from_speaker: already years and hundreds of billions of dollars in
yet to see a dollar of profit

our_interpretation: In context, profit refers to profit attributable to AI investment, not the companies' total profits.
The ordinary reading asserts both an absence of positive AI-attributable profit and a remaining revenue requirement associated with the stated cumulative capex.
The monetary gap is the speaker's estimate, linked to the preceding revenue multiplier; it is not presented as a reported balance-sheet liability.
Treat the assertion as cumulative through September 30, 2025, the latest pre-post reporting endpoint. Leave the starting date unspecified because years and the calculation date do not identify it.
Accounting profit and recovery of the original cash investment must be tested separately.
criteria.support_condition: Matched AI revenue and attributable costs substantiate the absence of positive profit for each named company, while a reproducible cumulative AI-capex and revenue-recovery calculation substantiates the stated remaining gap.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matching evidence establishes positive AI-attributable profit at a named company, or comparable cumulative investment and recovery data materially refute the stated gap. Broad company or cloud profits alone do not qualify.
